Episode 247. Liberation War of Laprarosa (18)
Thud, thud, thud...!

Laprarosa was collapsing. The golden roads melted and slumped in the heat, and the gigantic statues of the Plutonian warriors, which had stood tall on every street, were now miserably destroyed and rolling on the ground.

Ban's Plutonian Domination Sword had opened a blue rift that was now closing. The dispersing thunderous energy, returning to its original path, was significantly weaker than when the dimensional portal was opened.
"Phew! Lucky. Had we been a bit later, the path opened by Brother Ban might have closed."
Within the flowing golden roads, the hearts of light of the deceased Plutonian clan floated around. Tantel quickly spread a cloth and gathered these hearts of light.
Jin, with his eyes closed, began to add the thunderous energy of the newly recovered Plutonian Domination Sword to Ban's returning energy.
Then, the thunderous flow thickened, filling the area. The warping spaces seemed to solidify in its presence.
Spaces, squashed like dough, were returning to their original form. It was a dimensional error being caught by the thunderous energy of the two Plutonian Domination Swords.
At that moment, Tantel felt his own heart strongly resonating with Jin's thunderous energy.
"Brother Jin, we've reached the end."
Tantel said in a moved voice.
Until Jin and Murakan entered Laprarosa, he had been engulfed in anxiety. Even with Ban's greatness, he thought it seemed impossible to bear this terrible dimensional disaster alone.
However, as soon as Jin and Murakan arrived, the despair vanished like a lie. It seemed as if another deity had appeared to protect Laprarosa.
[It's not over yet. Brother Ban is proving that.]
"Haha, is that so? Seeing Brother Ban eases my mind. It's amazing that both the Battle God Brother and Brother foresaw this situation in the same way. Let's move on."
The three began to move.
Jin, concentrating on adding energy to Ban's, couldn't move quickly. Moreover, the dimensional error had not completely disappeared.
Explosions and transformations intermittently occurred in a space still shining a deep blue.
Without even having to put themselves at risk, it was a phenomenon that indicated danger. Even Murakan transformed into a human to reduce the possibility of being hit.
"The dimensional error will worsen as we approach the Hall of the Battle God. Brother Jin, Murakan."
"Tsk, what a mess. It's impressive that Ban has managed to stay conscious so far."
As Tantel said, with each step forward, more explosions and spatial transformations occurred. Like the depth of water deepening without warning, suddenly doubling in amount.
Jin did not hurry.
Although Laprarosa had always been in despair, not a single brother had died, and Ban was still maintaining the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword.
Throughout the war, enduring bombardment from the Red Plutonian's aerial fortresses, continuous spatial errors, and curses spread using the witch's power, Laprarosa had not collapsed.
In the distance, the Hall of the Battle Godcould be seen.
The majestic building, once boasting overwhelming dignity, was no longer there. The Hall of the Battle God looked like a giant ruined building, broken and crushed everywhere.
However, inside, the glowing hearts of the Plutonian clan who had survived the hardship were lighting up fires and roaring.
[Brothers!]
Soon, Jin raised his voice.
As they got closer, it became easier to send thunderous energy to Ban. Even though they weren't in Battle God Fusion, Jin could clearly feel the scene Ban was seeing.
Brothers who had fallen unconscious next to Ban, ordinary warriors trying to help even a little by emitting their remaining energy, Battle Kings cutting off the spatial rifts starting near Ban...
And right behind Ban, in the safest vicinity, the liberation device and Boras's figure, receiving absolute protection.
All of it seemed so vivid, as if right before his eyes, filling his heart with emotion.
No response came. Most of the companions, except Ban, couldn't even hear Jin's voice. They were consumed in pouring out everything they had.
As Jin entered the Hall of the Battle God through the collapsed gates, the storm of spatial error intensified.
Explosions so dense it was hard to take a single step spread, and sharp fragments of chaos left by Rokia swirled around.
'Rokia's cursed will.'
The Witch's Pool.
The curse had dispersed into Ban's Plutonian Domination Sword, but it had not completely disappeared. Millions of torn massive spirit energies were strangling Laprarosa like a plague.
The curse was making its last struggle to stop Jin. Already, several fragments of spirit energy had scratched Jin's cheek and various parts of his body.
It was an unavoidable injury while protecting Tantel. Murakan too was stabbed several times by fragments for the same reason.
"Brother Jin, would it be better to abandon me? I'll try to survive on my own. Don't waste the energy you need to save the brothers."
[What are you talking about, Brother Tantel? Did you eat something wrong?]
Jin burst into a wry smile. Tantel also smiled as if he wasn't serious.
"Trying to sound nice? I didn't eat something wrong, just haven't eaten enough. I'm starving."
[Let's have a grand drink with Jewel Wine after this is over.]
Whoosh...
Jin slowly regulated his breathing. Then the glowing hearts began to turn golden, and layers of golden rings started to unfold around Jin.
In the chaotic landscape, golden waves spread in all directions.

The waves maintained their form even when touching distorted spaces or explosions. Amidst the warping of Murakan's spirit energy and the thunderous energy of the Plutonian Domination Swords everywhere, only the golden rings kept their perfect circular shape, saturating the Hall of the Battle God.
The thunderous energy with the power of regeneration.
This power held a level that Rokia's curse, or its remaining fragments, couldn't harm. Despite being a new experience for Jin, he already knew it would turn out this way.
He understood. The power of regeneration is especially stronger against chaos.
Like waves shaping a beach, the spirit energy flowing out of the rifts was being cleanly washed away. The more it tried to escape, the more fiercely it was devoured by the golden rings.
Occasionally, spirit energy that had escaped destruction tried to penetrate deeper into the Hall of the Battle God. But the golden rings had already transformed in front of it, taking on a new form.
Eternalization.
Blue flames, like those of thunderous energy, blazed fiercely at the edges of the rings. The spirit energy, trying to cross this wall, screamed as if it were human.
Aaaargh, Gaaack...!
The dark sound characteristic of chaos vibrated through the Hall of the Battle God. The screams quickly subsided. Thus, the soul energy and traces of curse left by Rokia completely disappeared.
What remained was solely the storm of dimensional errors.
The explosions were beyond the control of Ban and Jin. They were the result of Laprarosa and the Human World, two worlds that should never have converged, touching and creating a massive error.
[Cough!]

Jin stepped back from an explosion that erupted right in front of him. The space where the explosion subsided turned transparent, leaving nothing behind. The original landscape, the objects that should have been there, all disappeared without a trace.
But Jin did not falter. Instead, he moved forward more boldly.
Dangerous.
To Murakan and Tantel, it seemed perilous that Jin was increasing his pace. Suddenly, an arm might disappear, or his head might vanish, leading to instant death.
But instead of trying to stop Jin, the two followed him without hesitation. Even Murakan did not transform into a human like before, preparing to support Ban.

A strange belief surged from the deepest part of their being. Even the dimensional errors caused by the convergence of the two worlds, even the explosions that could take the life of a god or a higher being, seemed incapable of killing Jin.
It seemed they couldn't even hurt him. In fact, the explosions occurred perilously close to Jin, but he had already endured dozens of them.
Finally, the main hall of the Hall of the Battle God came into view.
The last spirit energies trying to penetrate Ban's Plutonian Domination Sword were visible. There were far more than Jin had extinguished so far, but that was not a problem.
As Jin approached, the newly spread golden rings swiftly swallowed all the soul energies. Then, the suppressed Plutonian Domination Sword swelled up, and at that moment, Jin and Ban locked eyes.

Ban, with the sword planted in the ground, appeared to be praying, radiating thunderous energy. The energy, like water on the ground, seemed peaceful from another world, with fallen brothers and the liberation device placed over it.
"Brother Jin!"
Boras shouted in place of Ban. Ban was too exhausted to even speak upon seeing Jin.
Jin nodded at Boras, then cautiously approached Ban. Her hand holding the sword was as withered as an old person's.
Jin knelt on one knee in front of Ban, laying his hand over her clenched fist holding the sword.
At that moment, Boras, Tantel, and the conscious Battle Kings and ordinary warriors couldn't help but open their eyes wide.
Like a god resonating the glowing hearts of the Plutonian clan warriors, Jin's thunderous energy began to illuminate Ban's glowing heart.
Soon, red mist began to rise from Jin's body. The mist gradually drenched Ban, and it was Jin's blood.
Like the day he received the Battle God blood, this time Jin was transferring his own blood to her.
Then, Ban's fingers, dry as twigs, began to flesh out. It was as if Jin was breathing life into her.
Slowly, Ban raised her head.
[As expected, not too late, Brother Jin.]
[Of course. I'm finally repaying the faith my brothers gave me, Brother Ban.]
The two smiled at each other. The black wounds of spirit energy remaining on Ban's body had all disappeared.
Finally, the moment for the Plutonian clan to be freed had come.
